work_package: v4.1.0 G410-1 teacher trajectory-consistency audit (tolerance 8.0 px vs raw 1e-3)
question: On dev seed 1000 with the fast teacher and the rl_laser engine, is the raw 1e-3 trajectory_mismatch (2456/3251 = 75.546%) a strict-threshold artefact or a real teacher/verifier problem?
answer: Predominantly a strict-threshold artefact: the same 3,251 plans at tolerance 8.0 px mismatch 25 (0.769%), geo_dead_engine_alive and geo_alive_engine_dead stay 0, and the run still clears (13,004 frames, 0 deaths). 8 of the 25 residual plans are a real, reproducible model drift in the last 8 decisions before the stage change (139.583771 px), not threshold noise. This is NOT a G410-1 pass: one dev seed only; the 100 confirm-seed formal scope is still open.

environment.data_dir_note: same per-worker instance as WP02 fast20 worker 0; /root/v400-data/game was not written

command.deviation_from_task_command: --out used an absolute path (cwd fixed at the repo root); every other argument is verbatim. --binary/--engine/--data-dir/--expected-sha unchanged.
command.patch: touhou_rl.v400.teacher.decide.verify_plans = functools.partial(touhou_rl.v400.teacher.verify.verify_plans, tolerance=8.0) applied in memory by .tmp_v410_g4101_tol8/run_tol8.py before runpy.run_path('tools/rl/v400_teacher.py', run_name='__main__')

tolerance_patch.flag_disagreement_note: all 3,251 trajectory_matches values equal (max_position_error <= 8.0) plan by plan

calibration_cross_check.reference: WP02.4 CALIBRATION.md / labels_calibrated_summary.json (MODEL_MATCH_TOLERANCE = 8.0 px, pre-registered rule: smallest grid threshold with coverage >= 0.99 of died=false plans, capped at 16 px)
calibration_cross_check.note: the 8 px mismatch set is exactly WP02.4's 25 unknown plans; no plan moved between the two accounts

error_stats.within_1e_5_note: 31 plans exactly 8.0, 6 at 7.999994, 17 in (8.0, 8.001): the 8.0 line is knife-edge, not a gap in the distribution

classes.name: floating_point_boundary
classes.detail: 8.0 < max_position_error < 8.001; died=false, frames_advanced=32; excluded by the inclusive 8.0 comparison by 3e-6..1.5e-5 px

classes.name: stage_clear_window
classes.detail: first_action=0, duration=1, died=false, frames_advanced=32; the last 8 decisions before the stage 0->1 change; a real model drift (the geometry model does not reproduce the engine across the stage transition), not threshold noise

determinism.note: tolerance only enters VerifiedPlan.trajectory_matches / Consistency; plan choice and commits are unaffected, and the rerun reproduces the raw run plan for plan

conclusion.death_semantics_note: 0 died=true plans and 0 run deaths: the two geo counters are only exercised in the both-alive cell (agree_alive=3251); the dead cells get their positive examples from WP02.5 (7 verified_dead) and later runs with deaths
conclusion.v2h_note: POSITION_TOLERANCE lives in verify.py and is shared by full/fast/v2a..v2h; v2h only raises verify_k to 3, which scales the mismatch count per decision. The rate is a property of the plan mix and may differ somewhat per profile, but switching profile does not remove the 1e-3 semantics

limitations: single dev seed (1000), single stage (engine stage 0 = Stage 1), single difficulty (normal), single profile (fast: horizon 32 / beam 24 / verify_k 1); other seeds/stages/profiles are not covered
8 px is a model-consistency tolerance from the WP02.4 pre-registered rule, not a survival threshold; died is the only survival truth
0 deaths in this run: the no-contradiction result covers the both-alive cell only, not geo-vs-engine death disagreement
the 8 px line is knife-edge: 31 plans sit exactly at 8.0 and 17 just above it; a different threshold would move the count (8.001 px would leave only the 8 stage-window plans)
wall/time is not comparable to WP02 fast20 (452.6 s): an unrelated WP05 dagger-collect job (rl_v3 engine, different data dirs) was running during this audit
the patch is in-memory only: the shipped verify.py POSITION_TOLERANCE is still 1e-3, so any run that does not go through this wrapper still writes the raw metric
the plan-for-plan equality holds for this engine SHA + seed + data dir; a different build or polluted data dir must be re-measured
not_claimed: not a G410-1 pass: no gate/threshold/release check was evaluated; the 100 confirm seeds (61300-61399) were not run and no confirm-seed data was collected or used, so this single dev seed cannot stand in for them
not a new dataset or new labels: one dev-seed replay at 8 px; nothing was trained, collected or converted into training samples
not survival truth: 8 px is a model-consistency tolerance; the engine's died flag remains the only survival verdict, and this run has 0 deaths

not 'the teacher is fine': the 8 stage-window plans at 139.583771 px are a reproducible teacher/model-side defect (the model does not follow the engine across the stage transition), even though it caused no death misjudgement here
not a v400 source change: decide.py/verify.py/pos-tolerance are untouched; the tolerance exists only inside the run-dir wrapper
next_steps: report raw 1e-3, 8 px (or max_position_error distribution), geo counters and the concrete seed/plan list together for the 100 confirm-seed G410-1 teacher leg, instead of only plans_verified == decisions

put the 'execution and verification consistent' gate on the death semantics (geo_dead_engine_alive == 0 and geo_alive_engine_dead == 0) plus WP02.4's error <= 8 for label positivity, not on the 1e-3 flag

no tolerance fix is required before chunk3/4 (0.769% < 5%); if engineering budget is spent, target the stage-boundary drift (model does not rebuild the stage-transition frames) rather than raising 8.0
optionally rerun this wrapper on another dev seed (1000-1019 only, never a confirm seed) to check whether the 0.769% and the 25 residual composition are seed-stable
changing verify.py's POSITION_TOLERANCE would be a v400 source change needing its own work package and regression (tests assert the current trajectory_matches semantics); this audit did not touch it
